title: Thulasimathi and Manasi Clinch Gold at Asian Para Games
indian_angle: Indian pair Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Joshi secured a gold medal in women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton, contributing to India's strong performance.
summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Joshi won gold in the women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton event at the Asian Para Games, adding to Murugesan's two silver medals from earlier in the day.

title: India Crosses 100-Medal Mark at Para Games with Badminton Gold
indian_angle: The gold medal won by Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra in badminton helped India achieve its best-ever gold haul and surpass 100 medals at the Para Asian Games.
summary: India's medal tally at the Para Asian Games 2026 surpassed 100, with Thulasimathi Murugesan and Manasi Girishchandra's women’s doubles SL3-SU5 badminton gold contributing to the nation's best-ever gold haul.

title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha delivered a significant upset by defeating the second-ranked Japanese player, marking a notable achievement for Indian badminton.
summary: Ashmita Chaliha, a southpaw from Assam, defeated World No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi 21-19, 21-18 at the French Open, becoming only the second Indian shuttler after PV Sindhu to beat the Japanese star.
